title: Spinach Potatoes
description: This rich, cheesy side dish is packed with layers of spinach, potatoes, sautéed onion, and delicious pancetta. Try it for brunch, as well.
ingredients: 2 (3 ounce) packages pancetta bacon, finely chopped
5 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a medium baking dish.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and pancetta in hot butter until onion is tender and pancetta is cooked through. Remove from heat.
Alternately layer potato slices, salt and pepper, onion-pancetta mixture, spinach, and cheese in the prepared baking dish. Pour heavy cream over all. Cover the dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking until bubbly and lightly browned, about 30 minutes more.
